flow.name: axn-term - context menu copy/paste reaches the system clipboard
flow.description: Right-click the terminal and use the app context menu for real: "Select all" then "Copy" must put the selection on the X11 CLIPBOARD, and "Paste" must read a foreign-owned CLIPBOARD into the prompt. Runs on a private X server (Xvfb, else rootful Xwayland) with no clipboard manager — the X11 case where copied data dies unless the app keeps serving the selection (the Linux clipboard_write_text regression on desktops without a clipboard manager: works on macOS, silently empty on Linux). The desktop never sees the input.

step.description: Create temp state: one window, one plain shell session
Start a private X server with no clipboard manager
Launch axn-term on the test display
Print a mark, right-click → Select all, right-click → Copy: the mark must reach CLIPBOARD
Own CLIPBOARD with an echo line, right-click → Paste, Enter: the shell runs it
Close the app and stop the test display

assert.value: Copy put the selection on the X11 clipboard
Paste pasted the X11 clipboard at the prompt
